concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Keep steep concave profile and small summit vent. Strip concept orderly layers if any. Build coherent full-volume main mountain, broad lower skirt with radial dissection, sharper upper profile and small depressed vent. Use uneven branching/merging flank gullies and integrated divides, not repeated radial wedges like a lampshade. Snow in actual reference obscures rock, so snow-free subdued rock palette and erosional strength artistic. Material regions irregular not stratigraphic claims. Strong height to base ratio differs materially from batch79 shield.
